translation: The ear (耳) is the orifice that governs hearing. The name of the ear opening is called the cover (蔽), and the name of the ear rim is called the frame (郭). In all cases where the ear is cut, struck, or knocked off, whether it comes off above and sticks below, or comes off below and sticks above, internally use Feng Kou Yao (封口藥), and externally apply Xiao Du Ding Tong San (消毒定痛散); and behind the ear, observe the direction of the detachment, use a goose feather to clamp it horizontally and fix it, then use a bamboo clamp to bind it straight up and horizontally, and when binding, the two ears must face each other, bind gently, or use the reattachment method (綴法).
